"Look, a dog!"
First words

Made for little ones who can't read yet

Every card says its word out loud in a playful voice, and the speaker button repeats it slowly and clearly, as often as your child likes.

  • 12 categories: animals, food, colours, vehicles and more
  • Real animal sounds at the tap of a paw
  • Quiz and "Find it!" games to practise
"Colour the head pink!"
Colour & create

Colouring with a little twist

Children fill whole shapes with one tap, so pictures always look great. Spoken tasks turn colouring into a game of listening and colours, and your child decides when the picture is finished.

  • 62 pictures in five themes
  • Glitter, stripes, dots and stars
  • Stickers to decorate every picture
  • Finished art is saved in "My Art"
"Who says that?"
Games

Play that grows real skills

Memory, listening, counting and logic, wrapped in short games that end with a smile, not a "game over".

  • Animal Sounds, Memory, Simon and Word Match
  • Counting along out loud: "One, two, three…"
  • Gentle encouragement after every try
Rewards

Earn stars, collect stickers

Every finished activity earns stars. Children spend them on stickers for their very own album, with rare silver and gold Twigty specials to save up for.

FAQ

Questions parents ask

Which ages is Twigty for?

Twigty is designed for children aged 2 to 6. Activities start very simple and offer harder levels as your child grows.

Does my child need to read?

No. Every instruction, word and question is spoken aloud, so children who can't read yet can play on their own.

Is it safe for my child?

Twigty has no ads, no tracking and no accounts. Purchases, links and settings are behind a question only adults can answer.

Does it work without internet?

Yes. All activities work offline. An internet connection is only needed to buy or restore Premium.

How does Premium work?

Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or unlock everything once forever. The yearly plan starts with a one-week free trial for new subscribers. Subscriptions are managed and cancelled in your Apple ID settings, and purchases can be restored in the parents' section of the app.

Which devices are supported?

Twigty runs on iPhone and iPad.

About us

Twigty is made by ARTEVIA spol. s r.o., a company based in Prague, Czech Republic.

ARTEVIA develops and publishes Twigty, an educational app for children aged 2–6. We design the activities, illustrations and voice recordings with one goal: a calm, safe and joyful first step into learning.

Twigty is available for iPhone and iPad. Parents can try it for free and unlock all content with Twigty Premium. Purchases are handled by Apple through the App Store.

For questions, feedback or support, write to us at hello@sprouty-kids.com.
